defects.symptom: npm audit reported 4 High-severity advisories in transitive @grpc/grpc-js@1.9.16 via firebase.
defects.fix: Added package.json overrides pinning "@grpc/grpc-js": "^1.13.6" and updated lockfile to 1.13.6.
defects.verification: npm audit --audit-level=high (0 vulnerabilities across all severities)

defects.symptom: Enterprise IP/Country allowlist policy could be configured via /api/security/access-policy but was not enforcing on incoming /api/* and /s/:slug requests.
defects.rootCause: createAccessPolicyMiddleware was not exported or mounted on /api and /s routes in server.ts.
defects.fix: Implemented and mounted createAccessPolicyMiddleware(isLoopbackRequest) on /api and /s plus prototype-pollution guards.

defects.symptom: Hero Links were stored solely in an in-memory Map and lacked a DELETE revocation route.
defects.rootCause: Initial [WO-116] implementation used volatile in-memory storage without disk persistence or DELETE handler.
defects.fix: Added atomic mode-0600 disk persistence (.hero-links-store.json), reloadHeroLinksFromDisk(), and DELETE /api/share/hero-links/:slug.

defects.symptom: Missing X-Correlation-Id propagation and structured observability telemetry endpoint.
defects.rootCause: No centralized correlation ID middleware or latency/error percentile ring buffer existed.
defects.fix: Created server/observability/telemetry.ts with correlation ID sanitization, secret redaction, latency p50/p95/p99 tracking, and GET /api/system/observability.

defects.symptom: Adversarial boundary, Unicode/BiDi, prototype-pollution, and binary fuzz cases needed automated regression coverage across [WO-116] modules.
defects.rootCause: Unit tests covered nominal and primary error paths but not 100KB/BiDi/Mach-O/prototype-pollution fuzz vectors.
defects.verification: npm test (476 / 476 tests passing across 109 suites)

defects.symptom: Repository lacked an automated GitHub Actions CI gate and CycloneDX SBOM generator.
defects.rootCause: Build and QA scripts existed in package.json but were not codified into a CI workflow or SBOM generator.

defects.symptom: Root README.md contained 21-line AI Studio placeholder text and docs/release-readiness/ was absent.
defects.rootCause: Living architecture docs were maintained in RUNBOOK.md and farm/*.md while README.md remained untouched.
defects.fix: Upgraded README.md to full v2.2.0 architecture manual and generated all 23 docs/release-readiness/ artifacts.
